wanted_details.heading: Sanctions-designation details
wanted_details.status: Designated by OFAC on November 4, 2025 under Executive Order 13810, program tag DPRK4, for acting on behalf of Korea Mangyongdae Computer Technology Corporation
wanted_details.caution: Korea Mangyongdae Computer Technology Company (KMCTC) is an IT company based in North Korea that operates IT worker delegations from at least two cities in China, Shenyang and Dandong. KMCTC IT workers have used Chinese nationals as banking proxies in order to obfuscate the origin of funds generated by the DPRK IT workers’ illicit revenue generation schemes. U Yong Su is the current president of KMCTC.

sources.title: Treasury Sanctions DPRK Bankers and Institutions Involved in Laundering Cybercrime Proceeds and IT Worker Funds
美 “자금세탁 北 개인·기관 신규 제재” (United States sanctions further DPRK individuals and entities over money laundering)

disclaimer: U Yong Su is profiled here as the president of Korea Mangyongdae Computer Technology Corporation, which the Treasury says runs IT-worker delegations from Shenyang and Dandong and routes their earnings through Chinese nationals' bank accounts.
OFAC prints no Hangul for this name and the entry carries no photograph, so no Korean rendering is published rather than a reconstructed one.

The confidence level of 'confirmed' reflects that this individual is named on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals list; a sanctions designation is an administrative action by the Treasury and not a criminal charge, and nothing here states that any court has found anything.
